description: How Insolvia ships — and the rule that deploys happen in CI, never from your CLI. Use this whenever a task is about deploying, shipping, releasing, or "applying" infrastructure/services to staging or prod: "deploy to prod", "ship the API", "apply the terraform", "push a new version live", "run terraform apply", "update the lambda", "release". Read it BEFORE running any `terraform apply`, `docker push` to ECR, `aws lambda update-function-code`, or `aws`/`gh` deploy command against staging or prod — those are CI's job, and doing them by hand bypasses the OIDC deploy role and the environment gates.
